what: Mutation round 1 never passed Stryker's dry run: P13 (two settings worker processes) ran over the 10 s limit, P17 and P29 start Electron, and a name filter through run.sh did not survive Stryker's own name pattern. P1 in host/main.test.ts failed only under Stryker.
cause: Stryker's vitest runner runs tests in a worker thread, where process.umask(mode) throws, and it sets its own test name pattern.
fix: Tests round 10 skips P13, P17 and P29 only inside a Stryker worker (STRYKER_MUTATOR_WORKER), and stubs umask in worker threads so P1 stays in the run.
test: A narrow one-worker Stryker dry run on main.ts and main.test.ts failed before and passed after.
